description: Australian Electricity Demand Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Rakshitha Godahewa, Christoph Bergmeir (PhD Student at Monash University). This dataset contains 5 time series representing the half hourly electricity demand of 5 states in Australia: Victoria, New South Wales, Queensland, Tasmania and South Australia. It was extracted from R tsibbledata package. Coverage: national (AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
